title: THE SILICON FRONTIER // THE GLOBAL MICROCHIP RACE
subtitle: SEMICONDUCTOR SOVEREIGNTY // SPECIAL STRATEGIC DOSSIER
topic: The Global Semiconductor War: TSMC, Nvidia & The Silicon Frontier

cues.text: The global contest for artificial intelligence is fought on the silicon frontier.
Over ninety percent of advanced microchips originate from a single concentrated supply corridor.
From high-bandwidth memory clusters to extreme ultraviolet lithography, control over silicon defines superpower deterrence.
Export controls, semiconductor embargoes, and sovereign fabrication clusters are rewriting global alliances.
As computing clusters scale exponentially, the nation commanding this supply chain commands the future of intelligence.
This is not merely commercial technology—this is the foundational architecture of global hegemony.
The battle for tomorrow is etched in three nanometers.
